atmosphericPressure.description: The day's mean air pressure at the station's height (not reduced to sea level).

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for.

dateObserved.description: The end of the period the entity's newest readings cover, UTC: the hour of an air-quality mean, the local day of a weather station's values, the day of a well's reading, a traffic state's report, a charging point's newest port change.

gustSpeed.description: The day's strongest gust at 10 m.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

maxTemperature.description: The day's highest air temperature at the station. A property of this model: the Smart Data Model WeatherObserved names only the mean.

minTemperature.description: The day's lowest air temperature at the station. A property of this model: the Smart Data Model WeatherObserved names only the mean.

name.description: The name as the city publishes it, in Catalan (a station, an event, a facility, a street section and its stretch, a street address, a district or barri, a work, a tourist flat by its register number).

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

precipitation.description: The day's precipitation, in millimetres (litres per square metre).

relativeHumidity.description: The day's mean relative humidity, as a fraction (0.57 is 57 %).

solarRadiation.description: The day's mean global solar irradiance: the day's irradiation the city gives in MJ/m², times 10^6 / 86400.

source.description: The open-data file or the Open Data BCN dataset the entity was read from.

stationCode.description: The station's code in the network that runs it: the Catalan air-quality network (XVPCA, the city's codi_eoi, such as `8019043`), the Meteocat weather network (such as `D5`) or the Catalan water agency's well register (ACA, such as `08019-0148`).

temperature.description: The day's mean air temperature at the station.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

windDirection.description: The day's mean wind direction at 10 m, in degrees from north.

windSpeed.description: The day's mean wind speed at 10 m.

WeatherObserved.title: WeatherObserved

WorkState.description: The Smart Data Model CityWork workState values the city's states map to.
WorkState.title: WorkState
